preconditions.description: The input n must be an integer.
The input n must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '' if n == 0 else all(len(line) == i + 1 for i, line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: If n is 0, the output is an empty string; otherwise, each line has a length equal to its row number plus one.

postconditions.expression: all(line == ''.join(str(n - i) for i in range(i + 1)) for i, line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: Each line in the output matches the expected pattern of decreasing integers.
